entry_points.name: Current Home Resident drawer
entry_points.surface: Resident drawer in pmp-home-single-v6 loaded through pmp-home-single-v14 iframe shell

request_flow: User opens PMP Current path: pmp-home-single-v14.html -> iframe pmp-home-single-v6.html.
User opens Resident drawer and enters text in textarea#ask.
pmp-home-single-v14.html may patch residentRun first for lossless/inventory commands and then call the original residentRun.
pmp-resident-xray-core.js may patch residentRun to build X-Ray context before the original answer.
residentRun reads ask/paste/localStorage/sessionStorage, chooses a fixed command branch, and writes a plain local reply or a handoff packet.
reply_flow: Replies are created locally by plain(), setStatus(), or tool-specific answer/response functions.
The active Resident drawer writes div#residentReply, pre#residentWork, div#residentWarning, session chat, and recent work ledger.
Deep Resident writes div#askOut and pmp_resident_report_v1.
Safe Writer and Code Safety docks write JSON responses/handoffs into their dock output areas.
